description: Non motorized trail. Altitude: 860 m, Elevation Gain/Loss; 390 m, Hiking Time: 2-4 days, Hiking Distance: 50 km one-way to Vernon. After Cardinal Creek the trail stays near 1,250 m in elevation before descending to Kalamalka Prov. Park near Vernon. There are also 8 other points where the trail can be accessed to hike individual sections of the trail. There are many opportunities to viewpoints of the valley that crosses canyons, creeks, marshes, meadows and forests.
directions: Travel Time: +/-20 minutes from Kelowna. Drive on Hwy 33 south until you reach Philpott Rd. This is where the most southern trailhead is located.
